locations.note: Templars raid the Assassins' headquarters in Amritsar, taking the Koh-i-Noor and the Mentor Hamid; Arbaaz Mir later returns to free Princess Pyara Kaur from the Maharaja's Summer Palace.
Arbaaz follows a Templar expedition to the besieged citadel of Herat and its Precursor site.
Captured Arbaaz escapes the Templars at the Katasraj Temple in Punjab.

routes.name: Arbaaz Mir
routes.note: From Amritsar to the siege of Herat, captive to the Katasraj Temple, and back to Amritsar for the finale.
